# Black Marble

Black Marble is the fan-labeled white unicorn stallion glimpsed among the dressed-up crowd at Canterlot's Grand Galloping Gala in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. He has a charcoal-black mane and tail, pale blue eyes, and formal Gala accessories. His design resembles Shooting Star, but the shared model and accessories do not make them the same pony.

- **Name:** “Black Marble” is a community/wiki placeholder, not a spoken or otherwise verified official name. It was in fandom use by [July 2015](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/514484/new-game-paint-or-pony); who coined it is unverified. He is not Marble Pie or White Marble.
- **Appearance:** *The Best Night Ever* (S1E26, aired May 6, 2011). The [character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies) places his first sighting at approximately 09:47 in its episode timing. No second screen appearance was confirmed.
- **Speaking:** No identifiable spoken line, solo song, or verified voice-actor credit.

[![Attribution](https://derpicdn.net/img/download/2012/7/14/43564.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/43564)

*Grand Galloping Gala crowd screenshot, credited to the television production (Hasbro Studios / Studio B Productions), not to an individual animator. Black Marble is one of the small background ponies; this is not a solo portrait.*

## Important moments

1. **Pinkie's exuberance meets the Gala crowd** — *The Best Night Ever* (S1E26): Black Marble is identifiable among the formally dressed onlookers during the mismatch between Pinkie's party hopes and the restrained Gala atmosphere.
